---
key: testlaw:art-5
title: Right to erasure
lang: en
cross_references:
  - key: testlaw:art-6:para-1
    text: Article 6(1)
---

The controller shall erase personal data without undue delay where one of the
following grounds applies.

## 1. {#para-1}

The data subject withdraws consent on which the processing is based.

### (a) {#pt-a}

where there is no other legal ground for the processing;

### (b) {#pt-b}

where the data subject objects and there are no overriding legitimate grounds.

## 2. {#para-2}

Paragraph 1 shall not apply to processing necessary for compliance with a legal
obligation.
